posts.title: How to search DOJ/EFTA files
posts.x_text: An EFTA ID is just a lead. Verify the DOJ PDF and account for OCR errors. Here's the free search guide: https://grokarchivehub.com/guides/how-to-search-epstein-files?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=search
posts.angle: Start with a verifiable identifier; explain the difference between indexed text and original PDF.
posts.guardrail: Do not infer that an OCR miss means a document is absent.

posts.title: Financial Trust's 2012 $5.5M sale
posts.x_text: November 2012 records show a $5.5M stated sale and a $5,500,030 bank credit. Follow the document trail: https://grokarchivehub.com/evidence-briefs/financial-trust-black-family-partners-2012?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=ftsale
posts.angle: Explain signed package, stated price and bank-credit evidence separately.
posts.guardrail: The immediate origin of buyer funds is not established by the bank credit alone.

posts.title: How to read flight-log evidence
posts.x_text: Flight logs document recorded movements, not a passenger's conduct. Seven DOJ Maxwell-trial source links: https://grokarchivehub.com/guides/epstein-flight-logs-doj?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=flightlogs
posts.angle: Demonstrate DOJ-hosted PDF exhibit retrieval and how to interpret a row.
posts.guardrail: Presence on a log is not evidence of wrongdoing.

posts.title: The December 2007 decision gap
posts.x_text: GAH reconstructs the Dec 6–7, 2007 victim-letter hold. The final decision-maker remains an open question: https://grokarchivehub.com/investigations/epstein-december-6-7-2007-decision-gap?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=dec2007
posts.angle: Show the dated letters, defense papers, short email sequence and gap.
posts.guardrail: Do not identify a decision-maker without original confirming records.

posts.title: From $18M draft to $5.5M closing
posts.x_text: An $18M draft became a $5.5M closing. Follow the asset allocations rather than guessing why: https://grokarchivehub.com/investigations/black-family-partners-18m-to-5-5m-repricing?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=repricing
posts.angle: Walk through two valuations and the second reallocation within the $5.5M total.
posts.guardrail: Price changes are documented; motives and wrongdoing are not established.

posts.title: Official redacted contact book
posts.x_text: Being in an address book is not evidence of a crime. Locate DOJ's redacted contact book and its provenance: https://grokarchivehub.com/guides/epstein-black-book-redacted-doj?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=blackbook
posts.angle: Explain source provenance, release dates and cautious interpretation.
posts.guardrail: Never infer guilt from appearing in a contact book.

posts.title: Why the DOJ OIG report isn't enough
posts.x_text: An OIG report can anchor a timeline, not replace its source exhibits. Here's how GAH separates the two: https://grokarchivehub.com/investigations/doj-oig-report-as-backbone?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=oig
posts.angle: Explain official summary versus source documents and missing exhibits.
posts.guardrail: Do not imply official report completeness beyond what its text supports.

posts.title: The draft 2007 federal indictment
posts.x_text: The 56-page 2007 federal indictment was a draft, not a filed charge. Find the original DOJ scan: https://grokarchivehub.com/guides/epstein-2007-draft-federal-indictment?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=draftindict
posts.angle: Compare the 56-page artifact with other page-count claims, accurately qualified.
posts.guardrail: Never call a draft a filed indictment or proven charge.

posts.title: The buyer's $5.5M funding gap
posts.x_text: The sending account for a 2012 $5.5M payment is identifiable. The immediate funding source is still unresolved: https://grokarchivehub.com/investigations/black-family-partners-source-of-funds-gap?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=fundsgap
posts.angle: Distinguish sending bank/account evidence from upstream source of funds.
posts.guardrail: Do not assert origin of funds or illicit financing without direct evidence.

posts.title: What MCC video can and cannot show
posts.x_text: What can the surviving MCC video establish? GAH separates filmed coverage, the OIG record and open gaps: https://grokarchivehub.com/investigations/mcc-final-48-hours-source-chain?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=mcc
posts.angle: Use the OIG report and camera coverage to explain limitations of the surviving record.
posts.guardrail: Do not infer unrecorded events or assert that gaps prove an alternate cause of death.

posts.title: What a client-list claim proves
posts.x_text: Flight logs and contact books are not a verified 'client list'. Compare source types and the DOJ/FBI 2025 finding: https://grokarchivehub.com/guides/epstein-client-list-explained?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=clientlist
posts.angle: Explain the distinction between official findings and records describing contact or travel.
posts.guardrail: Do not imply a named person committed misconduct.

posts.title: Defense access and victim notice
posts.x_text: Who had access during the 2007–08 NPA? GAH traces defense access and delayed victim notices: https://grokarchivehub.com/investigations/epstein-npa-defense-access-victim-notification?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=npanotice
posts.angle: Anchor chronology to DOJ OPR and dated court/source records.
posts.guardrail: Do not infer unrecorded meetings or undocumented intent.

posts.title: A return-first Coinbase accounting audit
posts.x_text: $3.001M recorded cost. A $15M partial Coinbase exit. Three trust credits. What do the records actually connect? https://grokarchivehub.com/evidence-briefs/coinbase-return-first-15m-exit?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=coinbase
posts.angle: Trace cost, half-position transfer and corresponding credits.
posts.guardrail: No unsupported ownership attribution or additional returns.

posts.title: Barak receipts: presence versus conduct
posts.x_text: A name in an archive receipt establishes source presence, not conduct or motive. How GAH keeps that boundary: https://grokarchivehub.com/investigations/barak-receipts-presence-not-conduct?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gah_readership_065&utm_content=barakreceipts
posts.angle: Introduce provenance and entity-index interpretation without speculation.
posts.guardrail: No inference of crimes, motive, or legal responsibility from name occurrence.
